arguments.title: Acceptance test: review asyncio cancellation documentation
arguments.body:
Authorized acceptance-test issue for the fictional BLUEFIN project. This is a documentation exercise, not a claim of a production defect.

Checklist:
- Add a small example demonstrating a cancellation request, its observed result, and cleanup.
- Document the distinction between requesting cancellation and confirming completion.
- Review behavior against the Python version actually used before publishing guidance.

Retrieved evidence:
- Historical Python 3.6 development guidance: https://docs.python.org/release/3.6.15/library/asyncio-dev.html
- Version-alias development guidance: https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-dev.html

Acceptance: a human reviews the example and source/version relevance. No claim of universal cancellation or cleanup guarantees is made.
